init_multimodal_llama_model: initialize a MultiModalLlama model from a pretrained Hugging Face MllamaForConditionalGeneration checkpoint with auto device mapping
generate_multimodal_response: generate a text response from an image and text prompt using the MultiModalLlama model with configurable stop tokens
generate_with_grammar_constraint: generate a grammar-constrained response using IncrementalGrammarConstraint and GrammarConstrainedLogitsProcessor for structured output
generate_batch_response: generate multiple responses in batch mode using beam search and return a list of decoded text outputs
review_multimodal_llama_class: review the MultiModalLlama class that wraps Hugging Face MllamaForConditionalGeneration for vision-language model inference
